|gr1= GUI Control - ListBox

|arg= local

|eff= local

|descr= Sets the color of the item (right) with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user [[dialog]] to color.

|s1= [[lbSetColorRight]] [idc, index, color]

|p1= idc: [[Number]] - control id

|p2= index: [[Number]]

|p3= color: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= control [[lbSetColorRight]] [index, color]

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= index: [[Number]]

|p23= color: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>lbSetColorRight [101, 0, [0, 1, 0, 0.5]];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_control lbSetColorRight [0, [0, 1, 0, 0.5]];</sqf>
